name: story_structure_check
description: Check an outline's beats against a story structure: Save the Cat (Blake Snyder's 15 beats on their published pages of a 110-page script), Syd Field's three-act paradigm, or Christopher Vogler's 12-stage hero's journey. Give each scene's beat and its position (percent, or page of total_pages); get missing, early, late and out-of-order beats with the expected range in percent and pages.

beat.description: Beat id or name, e.g. catalyst, "Break into Two", pp1

tolerance.description: Percentage points allowed around each expected range

catalog.source: original; Blake Snyder, Save the Cat! (2005), ch. 4 (Beat Sheet pages); Syd Field, Screenplay (1979) and The Screenwriter's Workbook (1984); Christopher Vogler, The Writer's Journey (3rd ed. 2007)
